writes the slash-command's output to stdout

eval uses the same source-order orchestrator as batch (Decision 44 plus the 2026-09-03 macro-checkpoint amendment). A non-begin input supplies one REPL cluster, while begin supplies its inner form sequence.

Pass 1 expands only committed macros. Each direct or expansion-produced defmacro closes typecheck and codegen over its parent, clauses, and full expansion-time dependency/generated-realization closure, then publishes the parent, clauses, and current-module realization rows as one checkpoint before later forms continue. Dependency modules publish independently. A successful checkpoint survives later failure including the section 18 dependent cure, while a failed checkpoint exposes none of the new macro. There is no unpublished-candidate invocation or temporary GOT stack.

The fully expanded non-macro forms then enter one check_forms call (its internal signature/body passes) and one non-macro cluster publication. Thus non-macro forward-reference scope spans defmacro positions even though those macros checkpoint independently.
For the trailing expression, eval skips the non-macro definition commit and hands the typed AST to a fresh per-eval JITModule.

shared entry point — invokes the same source-order expand/checkpoint then single non-macro check_forms sequence shown in exec-flow-compilation. ResolutionGap loads foreign dependencies. Each dependency publishes independently and the current attempt retries from source. At this return, successful macro checkpoints are already live. ProcessedCluster carries only the still-unpublished non-macro transaction.
non-macro cluster-atomic commit.
Earlier successful macro checkpoints are outside this rollback domain. Triggers pending typecheck waiters and codegen work for the non-macro entries.
per-symbol wait — block only on the new symbol's jit, not on every pending in-mem item (global wait already happened at STEP 4)
[needs_codegen]

for defn redefinition — per-symbol reclaim of old Arc<Jit> when previous ModuleEntry's Code is dropped (Decision 41 reclaim semantics — D31 retired — substance amended into D41 at S64 + relocated at S69 Phase 3)
[one or more source forms — direct/generated defmacros checkpoint in source order, remaining definitions form the non-macro HM cluster]
same shared entry point and same gap-orchestration retry loop — FQ refs in the expression are resolved by process_form before it returns.
scope = current_repl_module for visibility, no commit target.
The wrapped expression is "(defn __expr [] expr)" but __expr is NOT committed anywhere — no insert_symbol call follows.
The temp closure exists only as a typed AST + per-eval JIT until the trampoline returns and the JIT drops.
enqueues BlockingJitCodegen for dep (priority-boosted) and waits — see exec-flow-compilation.

S76 W-Macro DECISION LOCKED — the macro-clause use of block_for_macro_codegen is DELETED (no same-module non-macro clause callee under the lock — macro-availability-model.md section 0.7). This eval-time value-expression dependency-codegen wait is an int-interior scheduler concern, re-synced when /dev lands the three-pass implementation.
[each un-codegenned dependency dep: FQSymbol in callees]
per pipeline-v4 §6.2 — fresh JITModule per eval call.
Wrapped in Jit newtype whose Drop calls unsafe JITModule::free_memory() (per Decision 41 §"Cranelift evidence" — D31 retired — substance amended into D41 at S64 + relocated at S69 Phase 3).
Temp closure has NO entry in ST_current and NO GOT slot — it is one-shot.

Per Decision 41 (+ S75 W2 Finding-A) backend writes ONLY the GOT slot via got().store_slot(slot, ptr) for entried symbols — the CALLER composes Code::Jit(Arc[Jit]) after the call (int wraps Arc::new(jit) — backend only borrows &mut M, never owns the Arc[Jit]). For the temp-closure case there is no entry / no GOT slot — int reads code_ptr from the populated Jit handle directly, and no Code is composed.
runtime cadence active inside the call —
atomic RC inc/dec, fork-join cells (lenient eval / par bind!),
IO trampoline if expected_type wraps IO _ (see exec-flow-runtime)
drop(Jit) — custom Drop calls unsafe JITModule::free_memory() —
__expr's executable memory is reclaimed before the next iteration
(safety holds because the value is fully consumed, GOT was never updated, and fn values are heap closures that go through GOTs not raw ptrs)
[trailing expression form (e.g. "(+ 1 2)" or "factorial 10")]
formats per repl/spec.md §1 — ":Type value — classification — docstring" for definitions, bare ":Type value" for expressions, etc.
per repl/spec.md §15 — persists current_repl_module's accumulated forms to {project_root}/{current_repl_module}.cl
[result is a definition or structural change]
[CommandResult::Nothing]

(imports during eval may have registered new modules — the watcher should now watch their files too)
STEP 7 — print next prompt with timing info from the just-completed iteration
[until /quit or EOF]
SHUTDOWN — on /quit or EOF
ensures cache .o + sidecars are written for all touched modules — next REPL session can cache-hit
signals worker pools to drain + terminate —
closes watcher channel — closes cache directory.
drop(Sess) — per-symbol reclaim chain fires (Decision 41) —
each ModuleEntry::Code drops, Arc<Jit> refcount hits 0,
custom Drop calls unsafe JITModule::free_memory() per symbol (one JITModule per defn under D41 cardinality).
